Tearing_Raptorial_Beak.description: A massive, heavily hooked beak made from solid keratin. Operating essentially as a biological pair of bolt-cutters, it is designed to cleanly sever the spinal cords of large prey and rip meat directly from the bone.

Generalist_Forceps_Beak.description: A sturdy, medium-length beak tapering to a precise point. While lacking overwhelming bite force, it acts as a remarkably dexterous substitute for hands, capable of everything from cracking nuts to manipulating primitive tools and picking locks.
